summary: Master Design Thinking to drive innovation and solve complex problems. Join our 5-day intermediate course for hands-on prototyping and user testing skills.
lede: Design thinking gives innovation, product, service, and business analysis professionals a structured way to turn ambiguous challenges into testable solution concepts. For practitioners bringing a real organizational challenge, the course develops skills in user research, evidence synthesis, and problem framing, then applies them to prototyping, experiment design, and presenting findings to inform decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who lead or support innovation, customer experience, product, service, and transformation work. It suits intermediate practitioners who can bring a real organizational challenge and want a structured way to investigate, design, and test responses.
modules: User Research and Jobs to Be Done
prerequisites: You should have practical experience in product, service, project, customer experience, business analysis, operations, or innovation work. No programming is required. Bring a current organizational challenge, access to a laptop, and any non-confidential user or process information that can support workshop activities. Advanced digital prototyping and AI-assisted research analysis are covered at operational application and conceptual awareness levels, not technical engineering level.
